details: VELDO-0078 detail: priority/missing-priority: the Gate's selection refuses it for missing priority, so the frontier does not offer it; every Gate station (plan run-check and the cycle's assignment step included) names its missing priority; the Gate refuses it at claim and at direct execution for missing priority alone; the VELDO-0132 cycle's assignment step refuses it for missing priority, and assigns prioritized work
VELDO-0078 detail: activation/decomposition-growth: the task claim refuses the appended unit, not admitted and not prioritized at the Gate
VELDO-0078 detail: blocked/resume-binding: an answer to this block shown another brief does not resume; the owner's refusal keeps it blocked; the owner's settled resolution resumes exactly that phase
VELDO-0078 detail: done/authorized-alternative: an answer shown another brief does not authorize it; the owner's settled answer authorizes the alternative outcome
VELDO-0078 detail: done/accepted-outcomes: each unit's outcome is recorded by its receipt or its authorization

VELDO-0078 detail: done/one-completion-reader: DONE recorded exactly the receipt the completion reader finds for each landed unit (AttributeError); a reader that finds no landing makes a landed unit a missing outcome; a reader that finds a landing makes an unlanded unit an accepted outcome; the backlog judges no receipt itself: no completion_contract, no receipt predicate of its own

VELDO-0078 detail: done/closed-unit: the backlog names the closed unit's missing outcome; the owner's settled answer counts the closed unit, which stays CANCELED with its close; then the item is DONE with that outcome
VELDO-0078 detail: other-process: the other process read the store read-only; it sees the DONE item and the admitted one; it gets the same executable answers; it gets the same outcome answers
